title: An Independent Reporter Loses His Home, Etihad Bets Big, and United's CEO Wants Chicago All to Himself
summary: The founder of Aviation Herald, one of the most trusted names in aviation safety reporting, just lost his home fighting a defamation lawsuit for reporting something that turned out to be true. Plus, a Russian smuggling ring gets caught funneling spare parts to sanctioned Aeroflot, Etihad announces a massive $20 billion expansion plan, and United's Scott Kirby has some very convenient thoughts about American's struggles in Chicago.
